intro: Plugins carry independent dependencies (native PDF/Excel/PPT and other heavy capabilities), installed on demand into ~/.rivet/plugins/. Install and enable/disable take effect on the next session — no mid-session hot loading, protecting the prefix cache.

dialog.title: Install plugin: {{name}}
dialog.effectDesc: Takes effect on the next session after install — plugin tools join the system-prompt tool list; changing them mid-session shatters the prefix cache
